title.en: Acts No. 1824  An Act to Fix the Time for Making Annual Reports By the Directors of Bureaus and Heads of Offices of the Insular Government, Provincial Governors, and the Municipal Board of the City of Manila, and for Other Purposes.
title.orig: Acts No. 1824  An Act to Fix the Time for Making Annual Reports By the Directors of Bureaus and Heads of Offices of the Insular Government, Provincial Governors, and the Municipal Board of the City of Manila, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
All Directors of Bureaus and heads of the Insular Government, all provincial governors, and the
Municipal Board of the city of Manila shall, subject to change by executive order of the Governor-General,
render annual reports for each fiscal year ending June thirtieth, and shall forward such reports to the
Governor-General or to the Secretaries of their respective Departments, as the case may be, not later than the
tenth day of August after the end of each fiscal year.

The provisions of subsection (k) of section forty-five of Act Numbered One hundred and
thirty-six, entitled "An Act providing for the organization of courts in the Philippine Islands," in so far as the
same requires a report by the Attorney-General on the first day of January and the first day of July of each
year, and all provisions of law requiring annual reports on any other date than that prescribed in this Act, and
all other Acts or parts of Ads inconsistent with this Act, are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 18, 1908.
